cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Move your haircut so we can have lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. We've been friends since school. Couldn't I have its place just once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They charge twenty pounds if I change it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pay. Put lunch in that exact slot, in pen. You've used pencil for me since school.

mechanism: A copies a calendar convention incorrectly and uses each clarification to demand B move a commitment as proof of friendship.
confusable: D10 selection alone is insufficient; D35 requires rearranging an existing obligation to demonstrate relationship priority.
seedUse: D35-a pays practical obstacle but insists on the same protected slot.
